event.name: c. 2910 BC: One estimate for death of Egyptian ruler Semerkhet; dates are debated

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: The 30th-century overview gives c.2910 BCE as Semerkhet’s death without an individual citation, and the page carries a citation warning. Semerkhet’s biography gives an approximate reign of 8½ years around c.2920; another chronology places his reign c.2930–2920. The calendar position and duration are uncertain. The one-year -2910 slot records one proposed death estimate, not a precise historical date. Tomb U at Umm el-Qa’ab is a regional marker; it does not establish the place of death.
r2SourceEvidence.date_precision: One approximate, disputed estimate; exact death year remains unknown.
r2SourceEvidence.location_precision: Regional tomb-site reference, not death location.
